newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms ratings for Hammerson.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms ratings for Hammerson.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Tuesday it had affrimed Hammerson Plc's long-term rating at A minus.
The firms short-term rating remains unchanged at A1, IBCA said in a statement.
"Hammerson's new management has completed necessary portfolio adjustments, resulting in an increased retail exposure whilst undertaking some limited office development," IBCA said.
It said further potential changes in certain overseas office portfolios were unlikely to be as profitable as the disposal of its Australian portfolio in 1994.
"The future development profile includes sizeable UK retail projects where joint ventures may be sought -- depending on the level of risk Hammerson's decide to retain," it added.
